pages.title: Death Egg Zone
pages.text: Death Egg Zone is the last level of Sonic the Hedgehog 2 (Sega, 1992). The Death Egg is Dr. Robotnik's space station, which needs the Chaos Emeralds to run, according to Wikipedia. VGMPF lists the tune at 1 minute 52 seconds.

pages.title: The part you never hear
pages.text: In the Sonic Stadium Soundtrack Squad Review (2010), the reviewer JezMM said that the part heard in the game is great, but "the unused portion of the song is just weird".
